title: Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System
source_id: Okla. Stat. tit. 74, secs. 901 et seq.
verified_how: queried the Legislature's own statute search (Title 74, SearchText 'Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System'): 74 current sections, concentrated in the 900-series (among those returned: 74-920, 74-921, 74-922.1, 74-913.1, 74-913.8, 74-930.7, 74-930.11, 74-935.3). 'Title 74 - State Government' confirmed on the titles index, currency 'last updated on November 18th, 2025'. NEGATIVE CHECK WORTH RECORDING: the same search for the phrase 'Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System Act' returned 0 results, so the system is not styled as an 'Act' in the statutes and that commonly seen name is wrong; the title given here follows the register.
notes: The opening section 74-901 was not individually confirmed because the register offers no section-level page and OSCN was unreachable; the citation is given as 'secs. 901 et seq.' on the strength of the 900-series sections returned by the register's own search. Old-age, survivors and disability insurance is federal (Social Security Act, 42 U.S.C. ch. 7). Oklahoma also has separate retirement systems for teachers, police, firefighters and judges, which are not listed because only one statute per topic is recorded.
